formulas.singlePhase: P = U × I  (U is L–N, or 240 V split-phase L1–L2)
formulas.threePhaseDeltaOrIT: P = √3 × U_LL × I  (no usable 230 V L–N; U_LL is typically 230 V in Norwegian IT)
formulas.continuousLoadSizing: Protective device ≥ 125 % of EVSE rated current (NEC 625 / similar continuous-load rules). Example: 32 A charger → 40 A breaker.
